after: Sort input-row indices through the existing cancellable merge sort; prepare item-kind and displayed-file-count arrays only when requested; project final records once.
methodology: Three paired Release rounds, alternating before/after ordering, fresh process per invocation, the existing wide browser fixture with 1,000 directories and 1,000,000 files. Both bundles include identical sort-phase RSS sampling. Sorting follows the existing index/search phases in each process; RSS is resident process memory, not allocated bytes. phase_peak_rss samples current RSS approximately every millisecond, whereas peak_rss is the process lifetime high-water mark. Cancellation is requested after half the measured sort duration, clamped to 10 ms–1.5 s, and includes cleanup. No overlapping build or test workload. All sorted-result counts and fingerprints match.
environment: Apple M5 MacBook Air; 10 cores; 32 GiB RAM; macOS 26.6.2; Xcode 26.6; local APFS
